contract_answer.question: What is the valid CPMLP baseline for Na-ion paper split 42 under the same locked configuration as NA-E000?
contract_answer.conclusion: CPMLP produced a finite, protocol-compliant split-42 baseline from the selected epoch-13 checkpoint. Independent recomputation from all 600 saved prefix predictions over 6 validation cells gives MAPE 0.233727, Acc@15 0.346667, MAE 50.1754 cycles, RMSE 62.5271 cycles, and bias -26.8075 cycles. Per-cell MAPE/Acc@15 are: 270040-1-6-59 0.055205/0.95; 270040-1-8-57 0.316212/0.00; 270040-5-3-37 0.402392/0.00; 270040-5-5-35 0.148057/0.32; 270040-5-8-32 0.368119/0.00; 270040-6-6-26 0.112374/0.81.

main_symptom: Split-42 MAPE is 0.233727, 0.107645 higher than NA-E000 split 2021 at 0.126081. The split-42 targets are much more dispersed (SD 63.92, range 102-307 cycles, versus SD 20.28 on split 2021), while prediction spread is compressed to 0.482697 of target spread. Three extreme-EOL cells have MAPE 0.316212-0.402392 and zero Acc@15, so a single six-cell split changes the headline sharply.

contradicting_evidence: The two runs change both the paper split and training seed, so validation composition alone cannot be causally separated from fitted-model variation.
On the overlapping cell 270040-1-6-59, split-42 MAPE improves to 0.055205 from NA-E000's 0.094240, so the regression is not universal across cells.
causes.interpretation: The strongest explanation for the 0.107645 MAPE gap is split sensitivity on only six validation cells. Split 42 contains both a 102-cycle cell overpredicted by 37.55 cycles on average and 255/307-cycle cells underpredicted by 102.61/97.08 cycles. Those three cells average 0.362241 MAPE and account for most of the headline, while the model's prediction-to-target spread ratio falls from 0.895771 on split 2021 to 0.482697 on split 42. This is evidence of poor generalization across the wider split-42 EOL range, not evidence that the run is invalid.
missing_evidence: The split-2024 repetition needed for the required three-split mean and standard deviation.
A controlled same-validation-set seed repeat that could separate initialization variance from paper-split composition.
Condition metadata or nearest-training-cell evidence for the three high-error validation cells.

contradicting_evidence: All prefix bins after cycle 10 remain in a relatively narrow MAPE band of 0.221911-0.234546, so prefix sensitivity does not explain all of the cell-specific extremes.
causes.interpretation: The first-ten-cycle bin is worst at 0.281326 MAPE, and perturbing padded values changes standardized output by 0.799729 on average and 1.714709 at maximum. The CPMLP flattening path therefore depends strongly on the locked zero-fill convention and may amplify prefix effects, but cached padding is exactly zero and no future-cycle leakage or validity failure is observed.
missing_evidence: Per-cell prefix trajectories across all three paper splits.

contradicting_evidence: The selected epoch is the unique minimum-MAPE epoch and training loss falls to 0.303882 of its first-epoch value.
causes.interpretation: Validation MAPE is noisy around the selected checkpoint, rising from 0.233727 at epoch 13 to 0.286505 at epoch 14 before returning near 0.24, so small-data optimization variance is plausible. However, all blocks have connected finite gradients and updates, activations are non-collapsed, the checkpoint rule is obeyed, and learning is not still improving at the boundary; the artifacts do not support an optimization failure.
missing_evidence: Repeated fits on the identical split-42 cell partition.
Train-cell-balanced prediction spread and bias at the selected checkpoint.

layers.reason: The block is healthy with finite gradients, late gradient-to-parameter ratio 0.002218, late update ratio 0.000284, near-zero gradient fraction 0.002220, and fully active finite features.

layers.name: intra_mlp.0
layers.role: Perform the CPMLP intra-cycle residual mixing block.
layers.reason: The block remains connected with finite gradients, late gradient-to-parameter ratio 0.000214, update ratio 0.0000648, and non-collapsed activations; no gradient-driven repair is justified.

layers.name: inter_flatten
layers.role: Flatten the masked cycle representations for the inter-cycle MLP.
layers.reason: The path has strong finite gradients and updates with zero near-zero-gradient fraction. Padding sensitivity is a known architectural limitation to test separately, not a defect in this locked baseline reproduction.

layers.name: inter_mlp.0
layers.role: Represent the nine-block inter-cycle residual MLP stack used by CPMLP.
layers.reason: The first and last stack blocks have finite nonzero gradients and updates, late near-zero-gradient fractions below 0.50, and fully active normalized representations. Layer reporting classifies every inter-MLP block as OK.

layers.name: head
layers.role: Map the final CPMLP representation to standardized EOL prediction.
layers.reason: The head remains connected and finite with late gradient-to-parameter ratio 0.014757 and late update ratio 0.0000436. Its compressed output spread is a statistical generalization symptom, not activation or gradient collapse.

screen_floor.reason: NA-E001 is a full-candidate baseline repeat with no matched reference_experiment, so the screening hard floor is not applicable.

next_action.summary: Retain NA-E001 as the valid split-42 CPMLP baseline despite its harder six-cell result, then run the identical approved configuration on split 2024 and report the required three-split mean and standard deviation rather than judging CPMLP from either split alone.
